entry.summary: A Heat Advisory is in effect for the Umpqua Valley from 11 a.m. Tuesday through 11 p.m. Wednesday. Highs of 96 to 99 degrees are expected in Roseburg and surrounding communities, increasing the risk of heat-related illness.

entry.title: Douglas County Honors Coast Guard Members And Umpqua River Lighthouse
entry.summary: Douglas County commissioners honored local Coast Guard members and Umpqua River Lighthouse staff and volunteers during a special proclamation ceremony in Winchester Bay.
